components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); color: var(--primary-color-text, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); border-radius: var(--border-radius, 4px); padding: 8px 10.5px; font: 500 14px Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-600, #36459a); border-color: var(--primary-600, #36459a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary-700, #2c397f); }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Secondary action inside forms and dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { background: transparent; color: var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 4px); padding: 8px 10.5px; font: 500 14px Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: var(--highlight-bg, rgba(63,81,181,0.12)); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Outlined Material input with float label, used in all forms.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-input { background: var(--surface-card, #ffffff); color: var(--text-color, rgba(0,0,0,0.87)); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.38); border-radius: var(--border-radius, 4px); padding: 12px; font: 400 16px Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; width: 16rem; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--text-color, rgba(0,0,0,0.87)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); padding: 11px; } .ds-field label { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--text-color-secondary, rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); font: 400 16px Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; pointer-events: none; transition: all .2s; } .ds-input:focus-visible + label, .ds-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + label { top: 0; font-size: 12px; background: var(--surface-card, #ffffff); padding: 0 4px; color: var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); }

components.name: Menubar
components.description: Hairline-outlined main navigation with the SuomiSF wordmark.
components.html: SuomiSFKirjatLehdetNovellit
components.css: .ds-menubar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--surface-border, rgba(0,0,0,0.12)); border-radius: var(--border-radius, 4px); background: transparent; font: 400 16px Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color: var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; padding: 0 12px 0 0; } .ds-item { color: var(--text-color, rgba(0,0,0,0.87)); text-decoration: none; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--border-radius, 4px); transition: background-color .2s; } .ds-item:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.04)); } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color, #3F51B5); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
SuomiSF is a reference work, not a showcase. Like a library card catalogue, its job is to hold a great many exact facts, keep them in order and lead from one record to the next. The interface stays quiet so the record can speak: the dense bibliographic data, the cross-links and the book covers.

The system is stock PrimeReact on its Material "mdc indigo" theme, deliberately close to its defaults. Components are quiet and utilitarian. Density and scanability come before flourish, because the main users are admin editors entering data and bibliographers checking it. Identity sits in a few consistent details: Roboto Slab headings, the indigo page titles and the covers themselves. It does not come from custom decoration.

Light and dark themes follow the visitor's system setting (`prefers-color-scheme`), switching between `mdc-light-indigo` and `mdc-dark-indigo`. Everything is coloured through the theme's CSS variables, so it changes with the theme.
keyCharacteristics: Stock PrimeReact Material components; minimal custom styling
Roboto Slab for headings, Roboto for everything else
Catalogue Indigo used sparingly, for identity and navigation
Gently rounded 4px corners throughout; square-cornered covers
Dense, scannable layouts on a 1140px container
Automatic light and dark themes driven by theme variables

rules.name: The Sparing Indigo Rule
rules.body: Catalogue Indigo marks identity and navigation: page titles, active tabs, links and primary actions. It is never a background for content areas or decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Variable Rule
rules.body: Interface colours come from the theme's CSS variables (`--primary-color`, `--surface-*`, `--text-color*`), never from hex values, so both themes stay correct. The one exception is data-visualisation palettes in the stats charts.

rules.name: The Slab-for-Headings Rule
rules.body: Roboto Slab is for headings and section labels only; all data, forms and running text use Roboto.

rules.name: The Theme Elevation Rule
rules.body: Only the theme's own shadows are used. No custom shadows, glows or layered effects.

dos: **Do** use PrimeReact components with their theme defaults before writing custom CSS.
**Do** colour through theme variables (`--primary-color`, `--surface-card`, `--surface-border`, `--text-color`, `--text-color-secondary`) so both themes keep working.
**Do** use Catalogue Indigo for page titles, active states, links and primary actions only.
**Do** keep Roboto Slab for headings and the uppercase 14px section labels; use Roboto for everything else.
**Do** keep 4px corners on controls and square corners on covers.
**Do** make links inside running text distinguishable by more than colour (an underline, or at least 3:1 contrast against the surrounding text).
**Do** keep layouts dense and scannable; the main users enter and check data.
donts: **Don't** hard-code hex colours in components; chart data palettes are the only exception.
**Don't** let links fall back to the browser's default blue (`#0000EE`); it currently happens in the main content area.
**Don't** add custom shadows, gradients or decorative effects; depth comes from the theme only.
**Don't** use white text on the light green success colour at small sizes (3.17:1).
**Don't** introduce a second icon set or another CSS framework; consolidate on what is already loaded.
